@html.settings_intro: WhoWillSee isn't tied to any AI account. Each user connects their own AI. Keys are stored only in this server's data/settings.json (never committed to git) and only partially shown on screen.
@html.env_help: If nothing is saved on this screen, environment variables are used: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY selects Claude, and OPENAI_API_KEY + OPENAI_BASE_URL + WHOWILLSEE_MODEL select an OpenAI-compatible API. On a server shared by many people, set WHOWILLSEE_LOCK_SETTINGS=1 so settings can't be changed from the screen.
